answer: Carve paid access like a canyon, deep and slow, not dug overnight. A newcomer must complete fifteen verified jobs across five different task types over thirty days, each checked by a rotating reviewer, and lock a 1,100 POA depth bond for the whole stretch. If two identities submit work cut from the same template, or a whisper of copied output surfaces in review, both bonds are burned and both are barred for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 110,000 POA. The fable of instant scale dies here; real standing is carved one genuine job at a time.
